glosses: nuclear; central (to a centre around which something is developed or organised)
nuclear (relating to the nucleus of cells)
nuclear (relating to the nucleus of atoms)

examples.text: O seu país tem armas nucleares?
examples.en: Does your country have nuclear weapons?

examples.text: As pessoas estão protestando contra as armas nucleares.
examples.en: People are protesting against nuclear weapons.

examples.text: O urânio é usado na produção de energia nuclear.
examples.en: Uranium is used in the production of nuclear power.

examples.text: Os físicos estavam cientes do perigoso potencial da fusão nuclear.
examples.en: The physicist was aware of the potential danger of nuclear fusion.
